chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Kulayb ibn Muʿāwiyah, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “Whoever kills in a sacred month, then upon him is a blood-money and a third more.”

key_terms.ثُلُثٌ: an added one-third increase above the base amount
key_terms.شَهْرٍ حَرَامٍ: a sacred month in which sanctity is heightened

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on blood-money for killing in a sacred month in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning unlawful killing committed during a sacred month. It establishes that the financial liability is increased, requiring the standard blood-money plus an additional third, which reflects the heightened sanctity of sacred times.
